context.heading: The setting behind the words
lead: Bourdain is discussing the risks that accompany adventurous eating. The surrounding passage contrasts accepting everyday food risks with refusing unfamiliar dishes. The amusement-park metaphor is a culinary argument in that setting, rather than an unrestricted instruction about every aspect of life. Kitchen Confidential text reproduction ↗
